'''''Tor 7863''''' was a [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] that was used by the company [[Tor-Ro-Bo Industries]]. At some point, Tor-Ro-Bo hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] some semi-processed [[TOL-type ore]] off of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]] and transport it to ''Tor 7863'', in breach of a [[Profit-Sharing Agreement Relaali 374.5.2|profit-sharing agreement]] that Tor-Ro-Bo had signed with the other corporations that operated on 244Core.<ref name="Imminent Impact" />
